records.jp: 私だけの“特別”を見つけた
records.en_original: I finally found something that makes me special.
records.en_auxiliary: I finally found something that makes me special.
records.en: I found my own “something special.”

records.jp: みんなの“特別”と出会った
records.en_original: I found what's special in everyone...
records.en_auxiliary: I found what's special in everyone...
records.en: I encountered everyone else's “something special.”

records.jp: なくしたくないって思えるものが初めてできた
records.en_original: For the first time, I'm afraid to lose something.
records.en_auxiliary: For the first time, I'm afraid to lose something.
records.en: For the first time, I found something I don't want to lose.

records.jp: たくさんのものをみんなにもらった
records.en_original: Everyone has given me so much.
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone has given me so much.
records.en: Everyone has given me so much.

records.jp: どれもかけがえのない、大切な思い出
records.en_original: Memories. Each of them precious and irreplaceable.
records.en_auxiliary: Memories. Each of them precious and irreplaceable.
records.en: Each one is a precious, irreplaceable memory.

records.jp: まるで夏休みみたいに、キラキラと輝いてる
records.en_original: Like summer vacation, every moment shines.
records.en_auxiliary: Like summer vacation, every moment shines.
records.en: They sparkle like summer vacation.

records.jp: 終わらせない、絶対に奪わせない
records.en_original: I'll never let you take it. You won't destroy it!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll never let you take it. You won't destroy it!
records.en: I won't let it end. I won't let you take it away.

records.jp: きっと、二度と手に入らない
records.en_original: Because I'll never have this chance again.
records.en_auxiliary: Because I'll never have this chance again.
records.en: I know I'll never have anything like this again.

records.jp: だから私も、みんなの大切なものを守りたい
records.en_original: I want to protect what's important to everyone.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to protect what's important to everyone.
records.en: I want to protect what's important to everyone.

records.jp: どこへ行っても、私たちは想いでつながってる
records.en_original: Wherever we are, our feelings tie us together.
records.en_auxiliary: Wherever we are, our feelings tie us together.
records.en: Wherever we are, our feelings tie us together.

records.jp: 何もなかったあの頃の自分とは違う
records.en_original: I had nothing back then. But I've changed.
records.en_auxiliary: I had nothing back then. But I've changed.
records.en: I'm not the same person I was back when I had nothing.

records.jp: 一つ一つが、私に力をくれる
records.en_original: I've been given so much power with every step!
records.en_auxiliary: I've been given so much power with every step!
records.en: Each and every one gives me strength.

records.jp: でも、夏休みは永遠じゃない
records.en_original: But summer vacation can't last forever.
records.en_auxiliary: But summer vacation can't last forever.
records.en: But summer vacation can't last forever.

records.jp: この輝きが、私に力をくれる
records.en_original: Its brilliance will give me power!
records.en_auxiliary: Its brilliance will give me power!
records.en: Its brilliance will give me power!

records.jp: 私は、私の想いを守るために――戦う！
records.en_original: I'll fight! To protect everyone's emotions!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll fight! To protect everyone's emotions!
records.en: I'll fight—to protect my own feelings!

records.jp: 私にできるのは、この想いを守る――ただそれだけだ！
records.en_original: Protecting everyone's feelings is all I can do!
records.en_auxiliary: Protecting everyone's feelings is all I can do!
records.en: All I can do is protect these feelings!

records.jp: それが私にできる、最大の恩返しだって思うから！
records.en_original: This is the best way to show my appreciation!
records.en_auxiliary: This is the best way to show my appreciation!
records.en: This is the best way to show my appreciation!

records.jp: このつながりが、私たちを強くしてくれる――！
records.en_original: These bonds make us stronger!
records.en_auxiliary: These bonds make us stronger!
records.en: These bonds make us stronger!

records.jp: この想いがあれば、私はどこにだって行ける――！
records.en_original: With these feelings, there's nowhere we can't go!
records.en_auxiliary: With these feelings, there's nowhere we can't go!
records.en: With these feelings, I can go anywhere!

records.jp: 未来につなぐんだ、この想いを――！
records.en_original: These feelings tie us to the future!
records.en_auxiliary: These feelings tie us to the future!
records.en: I'll carry these feelings into the future!

records.jp: 終わらせるんだ、この夏休みを――！
records.en_original: It's time for summer vacation to end!
records.en_auxiliary: It's time for summer vacation to end!
records.en: I'll bring this summer vacation to an end!

records.jp: 取り戻すんだ、私たちの日常を――！
records.en_original: Time to take our lives back!
records.en_auxiliary: Time to take our lives back!
records.en: I'll take back our everyday lives!
